oauth.scope.openid.title: Who you are
oauth.scope.openid.text: An identifier of your foodsharing account so the application recognises you.
oauth.scope.profile.title: Your profile
oauth.scope.profile.text: Name, profile photo, language and foodsaver number.
oauth.scope.email.title: Your email address
oauth.scope.email.text: The address you use to log in to foodsharing.
oauth.scope.regions.title: Your regions
oauth.scope.regions.text: Which regions and working groups you belong to or are an ambassador of.
oauth.consent.title: {client} wants to sign you in with your foodsharing account
oauth.consent.rememberHint: You will not be asked again next time. You can revoke this under “Connected apps”.
oauth.consent.footer: This request is valid until {time}. After that, start again in the application.
oauth.consent.regionRequiredText: {client} is only open to members of certain regions. Join one of them or contact the people running the application.
oauth.clients.title: OAuth applications
oauth.clients.subtitle: Applications that may sign users in with their foodsharing account.
oauth.clients.emptyText: Register an application so it can offer “Sign in with foodsharing”.
oauth.clients.kindHint.confidential: For server applications that can keep a secret safe.
oauth.clients.kindHint.public: For apps in the browser or on a phone; sign-in requires PKCE.
oauth.clients.disableText: Nobody can sign in through {name} until you enable it again. Consents are kept.
oauth.clients.rotateText: The current secret of {name} stops working immediately. The application needs the new secret to complete sign-ins.
oauth.clients.deleteText: {name} will be deleted; {count, plural, one {# consent is} other {# consents are}} revoked with all tokens.
oauth.clients.form.name: Name (shown to users when they consent)
oauth.clients.form.nameRequired: Please enter a name of at most 200 characters.
oauth.clients.form.clientIdHint: 3–60 characters: lower-case letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen. Cannot be changed later.
oauth.clients.form.clientIdInvalid: The client ID does not match the allowed pattern.
oauth.clients.form.redirectUrisHint: Only these addresses may receive the code: https, or http://localhost for testing. At most 10.
oauth.clients.form.redirect.invalid: Not a valid absolute address (without # fragment).
oauth.clients.form.redirect.insecure: http is only allowed for localhost; use https otherwise.
oauth.clients.form.redirectRequired: At least one redirect URI is required.
oauth.clients.form.redirectInvalid: Please correct the marked redirect URIs.
oauth.clients.form.grantRefreshHint: The application stays signed in without asking again.
oauth.clients.form.regions: Only for members of these regions
oauth.clients.form.regionsHint: Leave empty so every user can use the application.
oauth.clients.secret.title: Client secret
oauth.clients.secret.once: Copy the secret now. It is shown only this once and can only be replaced by a new one.
oauth.clients.secret.label: Secret
